items.en: Ukraine scales up counter-measures against jet-powered Shaheds: small air defence missiles due in October, a new Nika missile heading into testing, Spys interceptor test and German funding for tens of thousands of interceptor drones
items.nl: Oekraïne schaalt op tegen straalaangedreven Shaheds: kleine luchtafweerraketten in oktober, nieuwe Nika-raket gaat testen in, test van Spys-interceptor en Duitse financiering voor tienduizenden interceptordrones
items.sEn: During German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's visit to Kyiv on 4 October, President Zelensky said Ukraine will start using small air defence missiles against Russian jet-powered drones in the second half of October. According to Militarnyi, he said there are several types, that they are not yet in use, and that production…
items.sNl: Tijdens het bezoek van de Duitse bondskanselier Friedrich Merz aan Kyiv op 4 oktober zei president Zelensky dat Oekraïne in de tweede helft van oktober kleine luchtafweerraketten gaat inzetten tegen Russische straalaangedreven drones. items.en: Ukraine unveils indigenous Shershen SAM with R-120K missile and Ai-Petri anti-glide-bomb EW system at MSPO 2026
items.nl: Oekraïne toont eigen Shershen-luchtdoelsysteem met R-120K-raket en Ai-Petri-EW tegen glijbommen op MSPO 2026
items.sEn: At the MSPO 2026 defence exhibition in Kielce, Poland, Ukrainian company Radionix presented its modular "Shershen" (Hornet) air-defence system, built around the Perun command-and-control vehicle, the Athena surveillance/tracking radar (detection range roughly 85 km) and four Borei launchers per battery.
